_about: 1-Pentanol (1) + Isobutanol (2): isobaric T-x-y at 101.3 kPa. Rows: liquid mole fraction of 1-pentanol, boiling temperature in K, vapour mole fraction of 1-pentanol, as stored in the ThermoML Archive record (mole fractions of the other component converted with x_1 = 1 - x_2).

source.citation: J. M. Resa, J. M. Goenaga, Vapor-Liquid Equilibria at 101.3 kPa for Binary Mixtures Containing 2-Methyl-1-propanol + 2-Methyl-1-butanol, 2-Methyl-1-propanol + 3-Methyl-1-butanol, and 2-Methyl-1-propanol + 1-Pentanol, J. Chem. Eng. Data 51 (2006) 1892-1895
source.access: The journal article may be subscription-only; the same data is public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (NIST open license).
